_readme: pi-dark-factory HOLDOUT scenario — adversarial edge cases on a second port, same contract as runtime.json. Same black-box rules: outside the repo, foreground start, deterministic probes. Write probes the implementer would NOT naturally handle: malformed JSON must get 4xx (never 500/hang), invalid enum values, unknown-resource lookups, script-tag escaping, boundary values, rapid sequential writes. Record the API's actual behavior where the spec is silent — only a 5xx, a hang, or corruption is a failure. Setup runs in an EMPTY scratch dir with $WORKTREE (the lap's product worktree) exported — copy your artifact/build from there.
